summary: The table titled 'Financial Performance Summary' presents a comparative analysis of financial metrics for the periods ending December 31, 2024, December 31, 2023, and September 30, 2024. Key metrics include revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit, with growth percentages year-over-year (YoY) and quarter-over-quarter (QoQ) also highlighted. Notable insights include a 7.6% YoY growth in revenues from 2023 to 2024 and a 1.9% QoQ growth as of September 2024. Operating profit increased by 11.9% YoY, while net profit after minority interest showed an 11.4% YoY growth. The table provides a detailed view of the company's financial health and performance trends over the specified periods.
